and psp.PORTFOLIO_ID in
#{item}

#{item}

where 1 = 1
and psp.PORTFOLIO_ID in
#{item}

and not exists ( select 1 from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd where tpd.CASH_ID = fcp.CASH_ID and tpd.MDATE > FCP.VDATE AND FCP.MDATE >= TPD.MDATE and tpd.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TPD.IS_CANCEL='N' )

select DISTINCT '' as seqno, fep1.EXERCISE_DATE as CDATE, CONCAT(CONCAT(CONCAT(pp.PORTFOLIO_ID,'('), pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME), ')') as portfolioId, fp.ccy CCY , CONCAT(CONCAT(CONCAT(sci.ACCT_NAME ,'(') , sci.ACCT_NO）, ')') as fundAccount, case when psp.AMOUNT*fep1.EXERCISE_PRICE > 0 then ROUND(psp.AMOUNT*fep1.EXERCISE_PRICE/100,2) else 0 end as INCASHFLOW, case when psp.AMOUNT*fep1.EXERCISE_PRICE < 0 then ROUND(psp.AMOUNT*fep1.EXERCISE_PRICE/100,2) else 0 end as OUTCASHFLOW, ROUND(psp.AMOUNT*fep1.EXERCISE_PRICE/100,2) as NETCASHFLOW
from PTL_SEC_POSITION psp left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on psp.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY pa on pa.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id left join PTL_CAPACCT_INFO pci on psp.PORTFOLIO_ID = pci.PORTFOLIO_ID and pci.ACCT_TYPE = 'A01' and pci.ccy=psp.ccy left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = psp.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD on fp.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID left join (select fep.FINPROD_ID,fep.EXERCISE_DATE,fep.EXERCISE_PRICE from FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN fep where fep.EXERCISE_DATE = ( select min(fep.EXERCISE_DATE) from FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN fep where 1 = 1 and fep.EXERCISE_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'%Y-%m-%d') ) ) fep1 on fep1.FINPROD_ID = psp.FINPROD_ID left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci on sci.ACCT_NO = pci.ACCT_NO where 1 = 1
and psp.PORTFOLIO_ID in
#{item}

AND FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.PROD_MANAGER IN
#{item}
AND fep1.EXERCISE_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
